name: MDEQ air permit public notices, current and past
what: Read the past notices page back to 2017 and the current notices linked from the Air Division page at https://www.mdeq.ms.gov/air/, and list every gas or oil fired generator, turbine or engine permit of 50 MW or more, including data centers and captive plants.

name: MDEQ Permit Board agendas and minutes, full archive
what: Read the monthly agendas and the minutes archive (https://www.mdeq.ms.gov/permits/permit-board/minutes/) for every year since 2020, including the staff permit actions listed in the minutes, and list every power generation permit.

name: MDEQ air facilities that match no GEM plant
what: Answer every power or data center facility in scopes/us-ms/work/permits/_unmatched.md from scopes/us-ms/harvest_permits.py, among them Plant Sweatt, Cooperative Energy's Sylvarena and Benndale stations, Clarksdale's Wilkins station, Canton Municipal Utilities, the Entergy ERDC units at Vicksburg, the Discovery Energy engine plants at Hattiesburg, the Amazon and Compass data center sites, and Utility Optimization Group at Moss Point. For each, say whether it is a gas or oil generating plant of 50 MW or more that GEM lacks, a plant GEM has under another name, below the threshold, a data center for the watch list, or not a generating plant, with the permit as evidence. Also read the 2021 Permit Board minutes, which are missing from MDEQ's minutes index (look for the 2021 page in the Wayback index), and check whether Mississippi Power's Kemper County gas units have their own MDEQ facility, since the harvest matched the GEM plant only to TVA's Kemper combustion turbine plant.

name: Mississippi Public Service Commission dockets
what: Search the docket portal and the monthly docket lists at https://www.psc.ms.gov/exec-sec/dockets for Entergy Mississippi certificates of public convenience and necessity and integrated resource plans, the Mississippi Power integrated resource plan, and Cooperative Energy filings that add or retire gas generation.

name: MISO generator interconnection queue
what: Download or read the current queue (the interactive queue is at https://www.misoenergy.org/planning/resource-utilization/GI_Queue/gi-interactive-queue/) and list every gas or oil entry in Mississippi, then chase each one to a primary document.

name: MISO Expedited Resource Addition Study (ERAS) list
what: Find the ERAS section and every cycle's list of projects, and list each gas project in Mississippi with its owner and in-service date.

name: Southern Company interconnection queue (Southern Balancing Authority OASIS)
what: Open the Generator Interconnection folder on the Southern Companies OASIS (and the SIMPL portal at https://simpl.southernco.com/) and list every gas entry in Mississippi, mainly for Mississippi Power and other Southern Balancing Authority customers.

name: TVA generator interconnection queue and OASIS postings
what: Read the TVA transmission page and the TVA OASIS postings at https://www.oasis.oati.com/TVA/ for generator interconnection requests, studies and cluster results in north Mississippi, and list every gas entry. The OASIS menu is a script app. Its documents sit under https://www.oasis.oati.com/woa/docs/TVA/TVAdocs/: the queue was posted there as OASIS_CurrentQueue.pdf and CurrentQ.pdf (both gone from the live site on 2026-10-23; the Wayback Machine has a December 2022 copy of the first) and the quarterly interconnection meeting deck as IC_QM_Oct25.pdf. List that folder in the Wayback index, read the newest queue and meeting decks, and say in the note which copy you read.

name: TVA environmental reviews
what: List every TVA environmental review for a gas or oil fired generating plant, turbine site or interconnection in Mississippi.

name: EIA-860M newest monthly generator file
what: Read the Operating, Planned and Canceled or Postponed sheets for Mississippi in the newest file, and account for every gas or oil plant of 50 MW or more that GEM does not list.

name: EIA-860 annual survey, ownership and plant tables
what: Read the newest annual Ownership and Plant tables for Mississippi to confirm owners, shares and street addresses of gas and oil plants.

name: Entergy Mississippi news and plan pages
what: Read the newsroom and any resource plan or new generation pages for gas plants that are announced, filed for approval, under construction or being retired, including plants tied to data center customers.

name: Mississippi Power news and plan pages
what: Read the newsroom and any integrated resource plan pages for gas plants that are announced, under construction or being retired.

name: Cooperative Energy news releases
what: Read the news releases and any resource plan material for new, converted or retired gas generation, including small engine plants.

name: Possible updates sheet, Mississippi rows
what: Read the gas and oil plants tab through the work profile for every Mississippi row and answer each one in a record or a coverage note.

name: Captive LNG sheet, Gulf LNG Pascagoula
what: Use work/captive_us-mississippi.md from captive_lng.py (the sheet's Qualifying and Excluded rows) and decide whether the Gulf LNG terminal at Pascagoula has a captive generating plant that clears the add threshold.

name: xAI data center power, Southaven
what: Colossus 2 is already in GEM. Follow this report to the MDEQ air permit for the Southaven turbines and any later permit or filing, and check the two Colossus 2 units against them. Gas generation at any other xAI site is a new plant at the 50 MW threshold, or with capacity blank when no figure is found.

name: Amazon data center campuses, Mississippi
what: Check the Warren County and Madison County campuses for any on-site gas generation, gas or diesel engine fleets (backup fleets included) or a utility plant built for them (the Entergy Mississippi filings name them). A fleet whose summed electrical nameplate reaches 50 MW, or one with generators and no usable rating, is a new plant (briefs/_data_centers.md).
